# Environment variables

<!-- Generated from crates/koru-env/src/lib.rs. Do not edit by hand;
     run `KORU_UPDATE_ENV=1 cargo test -p koru-env` to regenerate. -->

Switches obey one rule: **on** when set to anything except `""`, `0`,
`false`, `no`, `off` (case-insensitive). `koru.bat envs` prints this
table with the current session's values; `koru.bat setup-envs` walks
the runtime switches one by one.

## Runtime

| Variable | Values | Purpose | Affects |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KORU_INPUT_DEBUG` | on/off | Logs every OS input event through the dispatch stages before any handler sees it; typed text is redacted, lengths and control code points are kept. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_WORKER_OWNS_GROUP` | set to 1 by the Agent's supervisor; never set by hand | Marks a unix Agent worker that leads its own process group, so on parent loss it may kill that group and take its descendants with it — the stand-in for Windows' Job Object (M24). Only a process that carries this *and* leads its group ever does it, so nothing else calling the same watcher can kill its own group. | koru-agent workers on macOS and Linux (sessions, gateway, delegate) |
| `KORU_RECORDING_DEBUG` | on/off | Session-recording lifecycle (internal builds): start/stop, window geometry, frame rate and derived bitrate, telemetry counts. Coordinates and action kinds may appear; never text, titles or names. Failures log unconditionally without it. | koru.exe (internal session recording) |
| `KORU_SEARCH_DEBUG` | on/off | Search routing and result-open diagnostics, to stderr and a capped per-process file in %TEMP%. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_GOOGLE_DEBUG` | on/off | Google Docs import OAuth, Picker, keychain and export stages — ids, counts and error codes, never a token or document text. | koru.exe (Google Docs import) |
| `KORU_GOOGLE_DOCS_CLIENT_ID` | a Google OAuth client id of type Desktop app (…apps.googleusercontent.com) | The Google OAuth client the Google Docs importer signs in with. Baked into a release build from .env.production; with it or its secret unset the importer is shown disabled with a reason. Supply your own registration for a community build (CONTRIBUTING.md). | koru.exe (Google Docs import) |
| `KORU_GOOGLE_DOCS_CLIENT_SECRET` | the same Desktop app client's secret (GOCSPX-…) | The Google Docs importer's client secret. Google's token endpoint asks for it, but for an installed app it is not confidential: it ships in the binary and PKCE is what authenticates the exchange. Baked into a release build from .env.production. | koru.exe (Google Docs import) |
| `KORU_IMPORT_DEBUG` | on/off | Evernote import diagnostics — parser pass, structural scope, stream offset, note ordinals, warning codes and resource digests only; never paths, titles, note text or encrypted content. | koru.exe (Evernote import) |
| `KORU_IPC_DEBUG` | on/off | Endpoint, handshake and every IPC frame, pid-prefixed so two processes' transcripts can be told apart. | koru.exe, koru-agent, koru-api-gateway |
| `KORU_SYNC_DEBUG` | on/off | The device-sync conversation, including ordinary peer connect/disconnect lifecycles; the shell, Agent, and Gateway share this one variable. Rapid reconnect storms remain visible at INFO without it. | koru.exe, koru-agent, koru-api-gateway |
| `KORU_RELAY_DEBUG` | on/off | Relay server per-connection and ACME diagnostics — client accepts and disconnects, certificate order progress and frame handling at debug; endpoint ids, counts and stages, never relayed content (which is end-to-end encrypted and unreadable to the relay anyway). | koru-relay |
| `KORU_RUN_MCP_DEBUG` | on/off | One line per call at a delegated run's MCP endpoint (/v1/runs/{run}/mcp) — the tool's name, the code it answered and the elapsed time; never an argument, a path or a title. | koru-agent --worker gateway |
| `KORU_STORE_SESSION_DEBUG` | on/off | Store bearer-credential renewals — the reason and the new expiry, never the token itself. | koru.exe, koru-agent, koru-mcp |
| `KORU_PEER_OBJECT_LOGS` | on/off | Adds per-object workspace_* replication stages on top of the sync log. | koru-agent, koru-api-gateway, Android |
| `KORU_CLOUD_BLOB_BYTE_ORIGINS` | comma-separated absolute origins, loopback or private-range only (http://127.0.0.1:8081, http://192.168.1.20:8081) | Names a local object worker this device may send blob bytes to, in addition to the compiled-in per-region set. **The production allowlist is not configurable**, because a configurable allowlist is one an attacker configures; this adds a local stack only, refuses any public host, and is how the two-device acceptance test reaches a worker on the tester's own machine. An unparseable or non-local value is refused rather than ignored. **Android has no environment to read this from**, so a phone is told the same value at build time through `koruBlobByteOrigins` in `apps/android/.env.local`, applied through the same allowlist with the same refusals. | koru-store-server (the blob transfer engine); a phone uses koruBlobByteOrigins instead |
| `KORU_CLIPBOARD_DEBUG` | on/off | Clipboard format names, payload sizes and line/block counts — never contents. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_SPELL_DEBUG` | on/off | Spell-check requests, timings, language tags and issue counts — never a word, sentence, suggestion or dictionary entry. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_UNDO_DEBUG` | on/off | The undo and paste-history chain; also on whenever KORU_CLIPBOARD_DEBUG is. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_CANVAS_DEBUG` | on/off | One line per request a canvas tab applies to its document (add, move, width, arrow, delete, text, agent, run, stop, undo) and whether it was refused — object ids, kinds and refusal tokens, never a card's text or a canvas's name. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_NAV_DEBUG` | on/off | Tab select, Store document swap, catch-up and spot restore — ids, counts and stages, never a title or row text. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_ACCESSIBILITY_DEBUG` | on/off | The native accessibility bridge per window: whether a provider was installed, when a screen reader attached or detached, semantic trees built, and actions routed or refused with their stable locator. Window and view slot numbers, occurrence locators, roles, counts and stages — never an accessible name, a label, a document title or any text a person wrote. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_ACCESSIBILITY_DUMP` | on/off | One dump of the exact accessibility tree a window publishes, taken when a screen reader attaches and never on a frame, timer or poll. Occurrence locators, node ids, parent and order, roles, bounds, states, actions, run and selection references, and counts - never a label, a document title, or a line of text. Costs one atomic load when unset. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_ACCESSIBILITY_DUMP_CONTENT` | on/off | Adds labels and text-run values to KORU_ACCESSIBILITY_DUMP, which must also be set. A local opt-in for debugging a synthetic fixture: the output then contains document text and must never reach a bug report, a log upload or a shared machine. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_TASKS_DEBUG` | on/off | Task command outcomes and the desktop wrapper's coalesced counters — commands run, activity attempted, activity dropped — and the two store-backed surfaces' waits on the read model: covered (with the interval since the write, in milliseconds, and the questions asked), gave up, unsupported, unpublished, query failed. Closed tokens, counts, intervals and a causation id; never a title, a due date, row text or a version vector. The store's own tasks counters are on /v1/debug/tasks instead, which needs no switch. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_HISTORY_DEBUG` | on/off | Version compare stages on the history worker — snapshot sizes, block and row counts and per-stage timings (fetch, decode, compare, unify); never document text. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_ATTACH_DEBUG` | on/off | Attachment slash command, pill context menu and open/save/reveal/restore path — stages and ids, never file bytes or paths beyond a basename. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_THEME_DEBUG` | on/off | Every system-theme read and apply, to stderr and a file in the temp directory. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_AI_PAYLOAD_DEBUG` | on/off | Logs one complete provider-neutral AI request JSON record and one terminal response JSON record per attempt, including authored context and provider output; never logs provider credentials. Also exposes the per-window system-prompt override in AI Settings. | koru.exe, koru-ai-chat, koru-ai-server, koru-api-gateway |
| `KORU_AI_HOST_ENDPOINT` | an https URL ending in /v1/ | Hosted Koru AI Chat Completions base URL. Missing this leaves the Koru AI provider unconfigured. | koru-ai-server |
| `KORU_AI_HOST_KEY` | a bearer token | Bearer token for the hosted Koru AI endpoint. Hidden in `koru.bat envs`. | koru-ai-server |
| `KORU_AI_PAYLOAD_TEST_CHILD` | on/off | Test-only: marks the isolated child process used to prove payload-debug records are opt-in and ordinary AI lifecycle logs remain content-free. | koru-ai-server tests |
| `KORU_FRAME_STATS` | on/off | Where a frame's time went, summarised every 120 frames. | koru.exe and every shell-based binary |
| `KORU_STARTUP_STATS` | on/off | Startup span timings — where the time before the first frame went; also arms the stall watch. | koru.exe and every shell-based binary |
| `KORU_SESSION_STATS` | on/off | Fixed-size terminal-session counters and timing histograms, reported only when explicitly sampled. | koru.exe session tabs, the koru-agent sessions worker, koru-api-gateway |
| `KORU_SESSION_DEBUG` | on/off | Content-free terminal-session lifecycle and state-transition diagnostics through the shared tracing pipeline. | koru.exe session tabs, the koru-agent sessions worker, koru-api-gateway |
| `KORU_DELEGATE_DEBUG` | on/off | One line per consequential event in the delegate worker — a status transition, a recorded step, a usage fact, a restart verdict, a refusal — and never one per provider event or message delta; run, attempt and turn ids, step kinds and counts, never an objective, a path, a prompt or a provider payload. | the koru-agent delegate worker |
| `KORU_DELEGATE_MCP_ENDPOINT` | an http:// or https:// URL | Overrides the base URL a delegated run's MCP endpoint is derived from (`<base>/v1/runs/{run}/mcp`); unset, the delegate worker uses the gateway it discovered. A stub until the run authority (P1.11) hosts the endpoint. | the koru-agent delegate worker |
| `KORU_RUN_MCP_TOKEN` | a run endpoint bearer, set by Koru | Not a flag a person sets. Koru sets it on a delegated provider's own child process, and names it to that provider (Codex: `mcp_servers.koru_run.bearer_token_env_var`), so the run's endpoint token reaches the provider through its environment instead of its command line, which every process on the machine can read. Setting it by hand does nothing: a launch overwrites it. | the provider child a delegated run starts |
| `KORU_LIVE_PROVIDER_SMOKE` | on/off | Runs the opt-in live provider smoke tests against the real CLIs on PATH; unset, those tests return without doing anything. | cargo test -p koru-session-runtime, on a developer machine with an authenticated provider CLI |
| `KORU_JANK` | on/off | The stall watch: logs any span over the floor (50 ms unless KORU_JANK_MS raises it). `koru.bat jank` sets it for one run. | koru.exe and every shell-based binary |
| `KORU_STORE_STATS` | on/off | Where the store's time went — metadata-only spans, reported at shutdown. | koru-api-gateway, koru-store-server |
| `KORU_EVENTS_DEBUG` | on/off | One line per event per hop — sent, recorded (with latency), derived, delivered — names, ids and timestamps only, never attrs. | koru-api-gateway (events worker), koru.exe |
| `KORU_EVENTS_DISABLED` | on/off | Silences the event bus: the journal is never opened, appends no-op, and every read answers empty. | koru-api-gateway (events worker) |
| `KORU_METRICS_DEBUG` | on/off | One line per telemetry delivery attempt — event count, outcome code, HTTP status, duration, and the event names and property keys; never a property value. | koru-api-gateway (events worker) |
| `KORU_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` | on/off | Whether the events worker has an upload destination at all. Unset, every channel has one; 0 removes it. It never grants consent: nothing is uploaded until the person opts in on this device (the welcome page, or Settings > System), whatever this says. | koru-api-gateway (events worker) |
| `KORU_TELEMETRY_BASE_URL` | a base URL | Overrides the built-in upload destination (https://m.koru.do); the /v1/metrics path is appended. Point it at a metrics service of your own during development. | koru-api-gateway (events worker) |
| `KORU_TELEMETRY_BATCH_EVENTS` | 1-500 (default 250) | How many events one outbound upload carries. | koru-api-gateway (events worker) |
| `KORU_TELEMETRY_TIMEOUT_MS` | milliseconds (default 15000) | How long one outbound upload may take before it counts as a timeout and is retried. | koru-api-gateway (events worker) |
| `KORU_ENABLE_CLOUD_SYNC` | on/off | Shows Koru Cloud: account sign-in (email, Google, Apple), the Koru Cloud page and its pointers. Off by default; a release bakes it on by setting it for koru-release, and a set value overrides the baked one at run time. | koru.exe, koru-agent (product surfaces) |
| `KORU_ENABLE_AGENTS` | on/off | Shows agent sessions as tabs (shell sessions are always shown). On by default; a release bakes it off by setting it to 0 for koru-release, and a set value overrides the baked one at run time. | koru.exe, koru-agent (product surfaces) |
| `KORU_ENABLE_AGENT_VIEWS` | on/off | Shows Explore's Agents and Artifacts views, which also need KORU_ENABLE_AGENTS on. Off by default; a release bakes it on by setting it for koru-release, and a set value overrides the baked one at run time. | koru.exe (product surfaces) |
| `KORU_ENABLE_TASKS` | on/off | Shows the Tasks view and its entry points (`/due` still creates a task). Off by default; a release bakes it on by setting it for koru-release, and a set value overrides the baked one at run time. | koru.exe (product surfaces) |
| `KORU_ENABLE_AI` | on/off | Shows Koru AI chat and Delegate. Off by default; a release bakes it on by setting it for koru-release, and a set value overrides the baked one at run time. | koru.exe, koru-agent (product surfaces) |
| `KORU_ENABLE_REMINDERS` | on/off | Shows the reminders UI (the reminder worker runs either way). Off by default; a release bakes it on by setting it for koru-release, and a set value overrides the baked one at run time. | koru.exe, koru-agent (product surfaces) |
| `KORU_ENABLE_CANVAS` | on/off | Shows canvases: the Canvases view (Alt+7), the `+` menu's Canvases flyout and canvas tabs. Off by default; a release bakes it on by setting it for koru-release, and a set value overrides the baked one at run time. | koru.exe (product surfaces) |
| `KORU_ENABLE_SOCIALS` | on/off | Shows Socials: the Socials view (Alt+8), New social post and the Socials tab, and starts the Agent's Socials publisher (off, nothing publishes; scheduled posts wait). Off by default; a release bakes it on by setting it for koru-release, and a set value overrides the baked one at run time. | koru.exe (product surfaces), koru-agent.exe (the Socials publisher) |
| `KORU_STORE_NO_DIALOG` | on/off | Suppresses the fatal message box when a store cannot open its databases — set by every store integration test. | koru-api-gateway, koru-store-server, tests |
| `KORU_AGENT_TEST_HOLD_SHELL_LAUNCH` | on/off | Test-only: keeps a rooted Agent's successful shell launch pending until the lifecycle fixture sends the matching Hello. | koru-agent lifecycle tests |
| `KORU_PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN` | an HTTPS origin, or literal loopback HTTP for local development | Sets the canonical public API origin used for fixed provider callbacks and native Agent account calls. Baked into a release build from .env.production, because an installed build has no environment to read it from. Without it the build has no Koru Cloud: sign-in and Cloud sync are off, and the app says Koru Cloud isn't set up in this build (koru_env::cloud_configured). | koru-agent |
| `KORU_PUBLIC_API_ISSUER` | the public API's HTTPS origin, or literal loopback HTTP for local development | Sets and verifies the account access-token issuer. Baked into a release build from .env.production. | koru-agent |
| `KORU_PUBLIC_API_CREDENTIAL_ROLLOUT` | optional strict JSON regional credential policy; absent preserves legacy issuance | Configures exact regional issuers, US residency, issuance stage, cutover time and purpose-specific legacy key ids. Contains no secrets. | koru-agent |
| `KORU_REHEARSAL_FAIL_UPDATE_HEALTH` | on/off | Release rehearsal only: makes a token-bearing Agent under an explicit root exit before publishing update health, forcing the real updater rollback path. | koru-agent rooted update rehearsal |
| `KORU_NO_GPU_WARMUP` | on/off | A/B measurement switch: puts GPU adapter, device and renderer creation (the shader compile) back on the main thread, at the first window. Nothing in the product reads it; CI sets it for the tests, because a runner without a GPU compiles on the software rasterizer. | koru.exe, koru-agent |
| `KORU_IROH_ISOLATED` | on/off | Deployment-only: isolated iroh networking with no shared relays or discovery. | koru-network-iroh (agent, store server, mobile host) |
| `KORU_VOICE_DISABLED` | on/off | Turns dictation entirely off: no voice worker starts, no dictation chord is bound, and every voice surface says it is unavailable. Nothing about a dictation is logged because none runs — and no path this switch guards has ever logged audio, a transcript, or a capture device's name. | koru.exe, koru-agent, koru-voice-worker |
| `KORU_UPDATE_SHORTCUTS` | on/off | Rewrites reference/SHORTCUTS.md during `cargo test -p koru-keys` instead of asserting it is current. | cargo test |
| `KORU_UPDATE_ENV` | on/off | Rewrites reference/ENV.md during `cargo test -p koru-env` instead of asserting it is current. | cargo test |
| `KORU_UPDATE_EVENTS` | on/off | Rewrites reference/EVENTS.md and the serialization vectors during `cargo test -p koru-events` instead of asserting they are current. | cargo test |
| `KORU_UPDATE_WORKSPACE_CRYPTO_VECTORS` | on/off | Rewrites the workspace-crypto golden vectors under contracts/vectors during `cargo test -p koru-workspace-crypto` instead of asserting they are current. | cargo test |
| `KORU_UPDATE_VOICE_VECTORS` | on/off | Rewrites the voice wire vectors in crates/koru-voice/tests/vectors during `cargo test -p koru-voice` instead of asserting they are current. | cargo test |
| `KORU_UPDATE_SESSION_SCHEMA` | on/off | Rewrites the generated terminal-session protocol schema during its focused snapshot test instead of asserting it is current. | cargo test -p koru-session-protocol |
| `KORU_UPDATE_PUBLIC_API_SCHEMA` | on/off | Rewrites the generated account wire schema during its focused snapshot test instead of asserting it is current. | cargo test -p koru-account-wire |
| `KORU_JANK_MS` | milliseconds | Raises the stall watch's floor; a non-number falls back to 50 ms rather than disabling the watch. | koru.exe and every shell-based binary |
| `KORU_JANK_LOG` | a file path | Appends stall lines to a shareable file in addition to the console; `koru.bat jank` points it at koru-jank.log. | koru.exe and every shell-based binary |
| `KORU_ASSETS` | a directory path | An assets directory searched before the exe-relative and source-tree roots; fonts are read from `<KORU_ASSETS>/fonts/`. | anything that draws text |
| `KORU_IROH_RELAYS` | `;`-separated relay URLs | Overrides the compiled Koru relay list with custom relays. Empty entries are dropped, and a value with none left counts as unset. | koru-network-iroh (agent, store server, mobile host) |
| `KORU_SEARCH_MATCH` | internal | One-shot match text handed to a child search window so authored text never appears in argv. Never set by hand. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_FEEDBACK_URL` | a URL | Where in-app feedback is POSTed; defaults to https://www.koru.do/api/feedback. Point it at http://localhost:3000/api/feedback to hit a local marketing site. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_SUPPORT_URL` | an origin | Desktop website origin for support and Cloud subscription links (scheme and host, no path), overriding https://www.koru.do; http://localhost:3000 uses a local marketing site. The app appends the locale and /support/desktop, /pricing or /dashboard. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_SUPPORT_DEBUG` | on/off | The support chat's routine lines -- boot requested, ready, the close-dialog choice -- to stderr. Never message text. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_WEBVIEW_DEBUG` | on/off | The embedded web surface's stages and navigation decisions, to stderr as stage, decision and host -- never a URL or a message body. On a dev build also opens the engine's devtools. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_WEBVIEW_FAULT` | create | Dev builds only: make the embedded web surface fail to create, so the support window's error state can be demonstrated without breaking the machine. | koru.exe |
| `KORU_NOTES_PREVIEW` | a file path | Test-only: writes a rendered release-notes HTML page there for eyeballing. | cargo test -p koru-release |
| `KORU_RELEASES_PREVIEW` | a file path | Test-only: writes the rendered release index page there for eyeballing. | cargo test -p koru-release |
| `KORU_NOTES_COMMAND` | `codex`, `kimi`, or a command template with `{channel}` and `{path}` | The generator dist-cloud offers for a missing release descriptor, and nightly-notes for a nightly's notes; `{path}` is the exact file to write. Unset, there is no default: the prompt offers codex or kimi, or stops so the file can be written by hand. | koru-release |
| `KORU_SIGNTOOL_COMMAND` | a command template with `{file}` | Authenticode signing hook for each packaged binary and archive; unset means unsigned. | koru-release |
| `KORU_WINDOWS_PACKAGE_PUBLISHER` | an X.509 subject name | Publisher identity for the signed sparse Windows notification package; must match the certificate used by KORU_SIGNTOOL_COMMAND. | koru-release and koru-agent release builds |
| `KORU_MAC_SIGN_COMMAND` | a command template with `{file}` | macOS codesign hook, run per helper and once for the bundle and the dmg; unset means ad hoc. | koru-release |
| `KORU_MAC_NOTARIZE_COMMAND` | a command template with `{file}` | macOS notarization hook handed a zip of the bundle; unset skips notarization and the release page says so. | koru-release |
| `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` | an API token | Cloudflare credentials for `cloud-setup` and `dist-cloud` — R2, DNS and cache operations. | koru-release |
| `CLOUDFLARE_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | an R2 S3 Access Key ID | Cloudflare R2 S3 identity for multipart release objects; set with CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. | koru-release |
| `CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | an R2 S3 Secret Access Key | Cloudflare R2 S3 secret for multipart release objects; set with CLOUDFLARE_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID. | koru-release |
| `RUST_LOG` | a tracing filter directive | Overrides a binary's default tracing filter — e.g. `koru_replication=debug`. | koru, koru-ai-chat, koru-api-gateway, koru-store-server, koru-agent, koru-mcp, koru-relay, koru-voice-worker |
| `WGPU_BACKEND` | dx12, vulkan, gl (comma-separated to allow several) | Diagnostic override for the GPU backend, read inside wgpu itself; wins over the Settings tab's choice in renderer.conf. A backend with no usable adapter falls back to the default and logs, rather than failing the launch. | koru.exe, koru-agent |
| `KORU_INTERNAL_STORE_READY` | an inherited OS handle or file descriptor | Internal test-only readiness channel for the standalone Store harness; never set by hand. | koru-store-server tests |
| `KORU_INTERNAL_SETTINGS_WRITE_FAULT` | global-dictation-enable, global-dictation-disable, or start-on-login-disable | Internal-build-only one-shot hold of one named confirmed settings reply after the authority receives and applies it; ignored by released builds. | koru-api-gateway (internal builds only) |
| `KORU_VOICE_MODELS` | a directory path | The speech-model cache, overriding both `--root` and the channel-independent default. It exists so a rooted test reuses one download rather than paying for isolation in gigabytes, and it deliberately points outside the profile root it overrides. | koru-voice-worker, and anything that lists or installs a speech model |
| `KORU_VOICE_CATALOG` | a file path, or an https URL | Where the speech-model catalog is read from, overriding the built-in `https://updates.koru.do/voice/catalog-v1.json`. A value naming a file that exists is read as a path and anything else is parsed as a URL, which must be HTTPS - so an air-gapped install and a fixture server are the same mechanism rather than two. It changes where an *offer* comes from and never what is trusted: every entry still passes the model trust policy before a byte is fetched - the pinned model-signing key, or, while the MVP key set is empty, the named digest-only arm that no stable build accepts (ADR-250's amendment). | koru.exe, koru-agent, and anything that offers a speech model |
| `KORU_VOICE_WHISPER_MODEL` | a directory path | Where the provisioned Compact (whisper) model directory lives, for the worker's recorded-speech acceptance test. Test-only: unset, the test skips rather than fails, because the weights are a deliberate download and never a fixture. | koru-voice-worker tests |
| `KORU_VOICE_BENCH_CORPUS` | a directory path | Where the engine benchmark's decision corpus lives, when `--corpus` is not given. The corpus is downloaded and never committed - it is gigabytes of licensed speech - so there is deliberately no default and no search path: a benchmark that silently found the wrong corpus would answer the engine question with the wrong numbers. | koru-voice-bench |
| `KORU_VOICE_BENCH_MODELS` | a directory path | Where the engine benchmark's provisioned model directories live, when `--models` is not given. Each chunk size is its own export and therefore its own directory, so this names a tree rather than a file. | koru-voice-bench |
| `KORU_VOICE_SHERPA_MODEL` | a directory path | One provisioned sherpa model directory, which the voice worker's manual dictating suite loads for its end-to-end proof that audio becomes text. There is deliberately no default and no search path: the weights are half a gigabyte and gitignored, so a test that silently found nothing would pass on a fresh clone while proving nothing. Unset, that suite reports why it did not run and passes; it is never a checked-in test that depends on a file most machines do not have. | koru-voice-worker, under `cargo test -- dictating --nocapture` |
| `KORU_VOICE_IDLE_UNLOAD` | whole seconds; 0 never unloads | How long the voice worker keeps a speech model in memory with no dictation running. Several hundred megabytes are only genuinely released by letting go, and five minutes is chosen so a person who dictates, reads, and dictates again does not pay the load twice. | koru-voice-worker |
| `KORU_VOICE_IDLE_EXIT` | whole seconds; 0 never exits | How long the voice worker itself stays running with no dictation. Ending the process is how the memory is released rather than nominally released, and Agent starts a new worker on the next dictation. | koru-voice-worker |
| `KORU_DICTIONARIES` | a directory path | Where the spell-check dictionaries live, overriding both `--root` and the local-data default. One directory per language tag (`en-US/dictionary.aff` + `dictionary.dic`), written by `scripts/setup/fetch-dictionaries`. The corpus and benchmark tests read *only* this variable and skip when it is unset - they never perform the default-directory resolution, so a machine with dictionaries installed runs the same suite CI does. | koru-spell |

## Compile time

| Variable | Values | Purpose | Affects |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KORU_VERSION` | set by the packager or build script | The version stamped into the binaries; falls back to the crate version in a dev build. | release builds |
| `KORU_BUILD_NUMBER` | set by the packager or build script | The monotonic build number; 0 means "not a release" and disables updates. | release builds |
| `KORU_RELEASE_CHANNEL` | set by the packager or build script | The data channel — store root, agent root, every IPC endpoint name. Compile-time on purpose: a channel is chosen by downloading it (ADR-113). | release builds |
| `KORU_COMMIT` | set by the packager or build script | The commit the release was built from. | release builds |
| `KORU_RELEASED_AT` | set by the packager or build script | The release timestamp; empty reads as "built", not "released". | release builds |
| `KORU_UPDATE_PUBLIC_KEY` | set by the packager or build script | The minisign key updates are verified against; empty disables updates. | release builds |
| `KORU_UPDATER_SHA256` | set by the packager or build script | The expected updater digest; empty disables updates. | release builds |
| `KORU_BRANCH` | set by the packager or build script | The git branch, stamped by the build script itself — emitted, never set by a person. | release builds |
| `KORU_WINDOWS_PACKAGE_VERSION` | set by the packager or build script | The four-part sparse-package version derived by the Agent build script from KORU_VERSION and KORU_BUILD_NUMBER; emitted, never set by a person. | release builds |
| `KORU_UPDATE_BASE_URL` | set by the packager or build script | Where update manifests are fetched from; defaults to https://updates.koru.do/, or the GitHub nightly release directory on Linux. | release builds |

## Scripts only

| Variable | Values | Purpose | Affects |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KORU_ROOT` | a directory path | koru.bat expands it to `--root` so a whole private stack (store, agent, app) runs beside your real one. | koru.bat, scripts/ |
| `KORU_FONTS_DIR` | a directory path | An extra directory fetch-fonts copies from before reaching for the network. | scripts/setup/fetch-fonts |
| `KORU_JAVA_HOME` | a JDK path | The JDK the Android runner uses, when discovery should not choose. | apps/android/koru.bat |
| `KORU_ANDROID_HOME` | an SDK path | The Android SDK the Android runner uses. | apps/android/koru.bat |
| `KORU_DEVICE` | a device serial or alias | Which device or emulator the mobile runners target. | mobile runners |
| `KORU_CONFIGURATION` | Debug or Release | The Xcode configuration the iOS runner builds. | apps/ios/koru.sh |
| `KORU_DEVICE_KIND` | simulator or device | Whether the iOS runner targets a simulator or hardware. | apps/ios/koru.sh |
| `KORU_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM` | an Apple team id | The signing team for iOS device builds. | apps/ios/koru.sh |
